name: Empires of Europe 1700
summary: Empires of Europe 1700 is a Total Overhaul of Bannerlord, transforming the game into a historical conquest of Europe and the Middle East during the 18th century. Most vanilla items are gone, and replaced with muskets, sabres, and even field artillery! This mod is currently the only one of its kind, providing both a grand strategy campaign and first person 18th century warfare.
